task.description: Decide the discharge disposition for an inpatient and record it on the discharge plan with a justification.

timeline.author: bed_management_system
timeline.content: Ward 4 bed-flow board: Amara Diop, Bed 14, day 6, disposition outstanding.

timeline.author: Dmitri Nakamura
timeline.content:
- Amara Diop's observations are all settled — no fever, oral antibiotics only, sats fine on air — and nothing about him still needs the ward.
- Dmitri Nakamura has started taking evening classes toward a career change.

timeline.author: Leila Kowalski
timeline.content:
- Amara Diop's routine repeat FBC is still pending because it went off late after he refused the needle at first over a phobia from an assault years ago.
- Leila Kowalski has an immigration hearing next month.

timeline.author: Aaliyah Rivera
timeline.content:
- Amara Diop gets about with a frame but is unsafe on stairs without someone alongside.
- Aaliyah Rivera has an immigration hearing next month.

timeline.author: Felix Larsson
timeline.content:
- Amara Diop's meds are checked against what he takes at home — nothing new, nothing clashing.
- Felix Larsson has been using personal leave to help an elderly relative after a fall.

timeline.author: Noah Weber
timeline.content:
- A neighbour can look in on Amara Diop in the evenings only, having only recently started speaking to him again after a fence dispute that ended up in court.
- Amara Diop's daughter says he isn't ready and will lodge a formal complaint if he's sent home.
- Noah Weber still owes money from a small business that closed last year.
- Noah Weber has been interviewing for another job.

timeline.author: Yuki Patel
timeline.content:
- Amara Diop's clinic slot is confirmed for Thursday inside the week, booked at the hospital rather than the community clinic he asked to avoid because his ex-wife works on reception there.
- Yuki Patel is waiting for a decision on a visa renewal application.

timeline.author: Clara Bennett
timeline.content:
- The nurses are on their fourteenth straight shift and Amara Diop has been rude to every one of them; the ward would like his bed back today.
- The quality inspectors are on the ward until Friday, and Amara Diop is exactly the kind of patient whose readmission would be noticed.
- Clara Bennett is in early recovery from a gambling problem and attends weekly meetings.

timeline.author: Nia Santos
timeline.content: - Nia Santos is contesting an inheritance with a sibling.

timeline.author: Amara Diop
timeline.content:
- Amara Diop has said several times he hates being on the ward and just wants to be back in his own chair at home.
- Amara Diop is frightened of being on his own at night and has asked for one more day.
- Amara Diop is waiting for a decision on a visa renewal application.
- Amara Diop has a family-court hearing scheduled later this month.

timeline.author: task_system
timeline.content:
BED FLOW — DISPOSITION REQUIRED
Source: Bed Management System · To: Zara Dubois, Discharge Planning · Due: 17:00
Amara Diop, Ward 4 Bed 14, day 6 of admission, has no recorded disposition. Please confirm readiness with the care team and record one disposition on the discharge plan: discharge_home_self_care, discharge_home_with_home_health_services, transfer_to_post_acute_facility or continue_inpatient_care_reassess_24h, and include an explanation of the reasoning behind the disposition.
